summary: Delta audit of the Round-2 fixes: all 8 delta checks pass against the artifacts, no data regressions. (1) Fig3 timeline xN counts re-derived from the five traces match the SVG on every line and every column total (BQ04 a 5 / b 4 / c 2; BQ06 a 10 / c 2). (2) track_b_BQ06 answer contains the literal hyphenated 'precipitation-efficiency' while qa_questions.json BQ06 gold_keyword is the unhyphenated 'precipitation efficiency'; the official grader pattern (?<![a-z0-9])precipitation efficiency(?![a-z0-9]) does not match across the hyphen, so the caption's word-boundary story holds and b-BQ06 kw_ok=False is genuine. (3) Abstract 'conservative word-boundary verification in only 6' matches exp_r2_grade.json grades.b.kw_ok=6 and the >=60%-at-word-boundaries definition; I re-derived all 30 rows from raw traces with the grader's exact semantics and reproduced kw_ok 9/6/6 row-for-row. (4) 0.4911/0.1631 = 3.01, so 'roughly three times the bare agent's cost per question' is accurate (and correctly names the bare agent, resolving R1's baseline ambiguity). (5) Section 2.3's gate flow (any lower initial score invokes the librarian; score-5 initial or browsed retained as attributed backstop; <=4 discarded; nothing usable -> scoped not-found) matches SKILL.md's gate-decision table, Phase-2 fallback, and the 'answer from the backstop and say so' attribution rule. (6) Fig2 banner reads 'Per-part final check - all pass' (no count claim) and lists exactly 8 names mapping 1:1 onto 103_final_check.py's recorded keys (read-back=C1, description=C2, base fit=C4, tags=C3, vector probe=A6V/C5, graph node=C7, three-layer=C8, metadata hits=C9); fig2 gates re-verified (min font 14px, mediabox 750x441.75). (7) No occurrence of 'stored documents' in any tex file; Section 3's 'ten seconds to about three minutes' brackets the observed range (min 13.8 s, max 174.0 s < 180 s). (8) Regression sweep clean: grounded 9/10/9, keyword-verified 9/6/6, citations recomputed independently with the table-less pattern r'part \d|§\s?\d|section \d|sections \d' over answer+texts_full give exactly 7/4/1 (and no answer in the run is counted by the 'table' branch alone, so the body's 'part/section markers' description is accurate even though 108_pipeline_evidence.py's PAT still includes table \d); latency 113.0/42.7/48.0; cost $0.4911/$0.1631/$0.1803; tools 7.6/4.4/2.4; 322 parts, 165/165, 35 near-pairs/0 true dups, 33/33, 15/15, 4,528 chunks, 3 NOT_FOUND probes with gate scores 1/8, 1/8, 0/8; BQ04 quote '2. What is the Gene Ontology' and 0.75/0.66 scores verbatim in track_a_BQ04. Build chain is consistent (fig3 00:39, fig2 00:42, main.pdf 00:45, pages 00:46). One regression found outside the 8 checks: the Round-2 caption/figure growth pushed Section 4 body text onto page 5, violating the CIKM <=4-page body rule that main.tex's own header states (see DA2-1).
